    bore_d = p.bearing_od + 2.0 * p.bearing_fit_clearance

        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .circle(p.wheel_od / 2.0)
        .circle(p.lip_id / 2.0)
        .extrude(p.wheel_width)
    )

    wp = wp.edges(cq.selectors.RadiusNthSelector(1)).chamfer(p.rim_chamfer)

    recess_tool = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .workplane(offset=hub_h)
        .circle(p.hub_recess_d / 2.0)
        .extrude(p.wheel_width - hub_h + 1.0)
    )
    wp = wp.cut(recess_tool)

    bore_tool = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .workplane(offset=p.lip_h)
        .circle(bore_d / 2.0)
        .extrude(p.wheel_width - p.lip_h + 1.0)
    )
    wp = wp.cut(bore_tool)

    return wp
